_comment: Project hooks approved by Vinay 2026-09-03 (prompt audit, hunk 22), rewritten after adversarial verification. PreToolUse/Bash runs .claude/hooks/pre_bash.sh: blocks deletion of tracked VTU/PRJ under Tests/Data and of any .md (CLAUDE.md 6.2/6.3) and gives an early warning on a Claude co-author trailer (7); the authoritative 7 check is the shared git hook .git/hooks/commit-msg. PostToolUse runs xmllint --noout on every edited PRJ (memory: incident_xml_double_hyphen_comment_parse).

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in *.prj|*.PRJ) xmllint --noout "$f" || { echo "xmllint failed on $f: check for a -- inside an XML comment (memory: incident_xml_double_hyphen_comment_parse)" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
